users.title: Users
users.description: Who signs in to Housetel, with which role and for which hotels.
users.deactivateDescription: They can no longer sign in to Housetel. Their history is kept and you can reactivate them anytime.
users.locked: They have permissions or hotels you don't: only someone with wider access can change them.

invitations.title: Pending invitations
invitations.description: People who haven't accepted yet. Each link expires after 7 days.
invitations.revokeDescription: The link stops working. You can invite this person again later.
invitations.emailFailed: We couldn't send the email. Copy the link and share it another way.
invitations.locked: It grants permissions or hotels you don't have: only someone with wider access can resend or revoke it.

inviteDialog.title: Invite your team
inviteDialog.description: We email them a link to create their account and sign in.
inviteDialog.allPropertiesLocked: You can only give access to the hotels you work in.

memberDialog.title: {{name}}'s access
memberDialog.description: The role sets what they can do; the hotels, where.

roles.title: Roles & permissions
roles.description: What each person can see and do, according to their role.
roles.noCustom: No custom roles yet. Duplicate a template or create one from scratch.
roles.systemHint: Housetel templates can't be edited: duplicate one to adapt it to your hotel.
roles.name: Role name
roles.deleteDescription: Only roles that nobody holds and with no pending invitations can be deleted.
roles.locked: This role has permissions you don't have, so you can't edit it.

matrix.cannotGrant: You can't grant a permission you don't have.

invite.title: Join {{organization}}
invite.invitedNoName: You were invited with the role {{role}}.
invite.existing: You already have a Housetel account with {{email}}. Enter your password to join.
invite.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Avoid common passwords or numbers only.
invite.wrongPassword: The password doesn't match your Housetel account.
invite.expiredText: Ask whoever invited you to send it again.
invite.usedText: If you already created your account, sign in.
invite.notFoundText: Check that the link is complete or ask for a new invitation.
invite.passwordTooShort: Create a password with at least {{min}} characters
invite.signedInAs: You are signed in as {{current}}. Joining signs you in as {{email}}.

errors.throttled: Too many attempts in a row. Wait a few minutes and try again.

password.onlyNumbers: Include letters or symbols, not only numbers.

scene.recodeCaption: Saving the new password stops the old keys from opening: we sign you out on your other devices.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.subtitle: Enter the email you sign in to Housetel with and we'll send you a link to choose a new one.
forgot.sentText: If {{email}} belongs to a Housetel account, we sent it a link to choose a new password.
forgot.tipOnce: The link works once. If you ask for another one, open the latest.
forgot.tipSpam: Nothing after a few minutes? Check your spam and promotions folders.
forgot.throttled: Too many requests in a row. Wait a few minutes and try again.
forgot.devMailbox: In development, emails land in Mailpit:

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.subtitle: For the account {{email}}.
reset.sessionsNote: Saving it signs you in to Housetel and signs you out on your other devices.
reset.done: Password updated. We signed you out on your other devices.
reset.invalidText: Password reset links work once and expire. Ask for a new one and open the latest you get.

verify.alreadyText: {{email}} was already verified. There is nothing else to do.
verify.expiredText: Email confirmation links last 7 days. Ask for a new one and open it from your email.
verify.invalidText: Check that the link is complete: some email apps split it in two lines. If it still fails, ask for a new one.
verify.loginToResend: Sign in to ask for another

verification.sent: We sent a new link to {{email}}.
verification.throttled: You already asked for several links. Wait a while before asking again.
verification.emailUnavailable: We couldn't send the email. Try again in a few minutes.

chip.label: Verify your email
chip.title: Confirm your email
chip.text: We sent a link to {{email}}. Open it to confirm the address is yours and that your account notices reach you.

account.title: My account & security
account.description: Your email, your password and how you get back in.

email.title: Email
email.description: You sign in to Housetel with this email and get your account notices there.
email.pending: We sent a link to this email. Open it to confirm it's yours and that your account notices, like password recovery links, reach you.

password.title: Password
password.description: Change it whenever you want; we ask for the current one to confirm it's you.
password.changed: Password changed. We signed you out on your other devices.
password.wrongCurrent: The current password is not correct.
password.samePassword: The new password must be different from the current one.
password.sessionsNote: After the change you stay signed in here, we sign you out on your other devices and let you know by email.
